scope: E0 independent M3 bivariate OOS 1X2; no production M9 or Crown
method: Train per-team residual = observed points (win 1/draw 0.5) minus predicted points (Pwin+0.5 Pdraw), using ONLY prior two seasons' independent OOS forecasts. Compare 1X2 log loss of baseline vs corrected on next held-out season. Per-team attribution splits each fixture's gain equally between home and away participants; this is attribution, not isolated causal effect.
caveats: R50 independent M3 season-forward model, not M9 production; score-grid and Crown AH unavailable.
Per-team gains allocate shared match gains 50/50, not an independent team effect.
Team residuals are observed from prior two seasons, with promoted teams potentially absent.
This analysis reuses R50 data, not an independent replication.
Match-level IID bootstrap 4000 replicates is exploratory and ignores fixture/team/time dependence; not a formal proof of persistent edge.
